text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this three-way clash
is... Aston
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-wowee! That three-way standoff was
absolute
fire!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I was here to witness this! I
have a
feeling we just saw something
really special...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did it... I won!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Machan!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Agh... Damn... Damn it! I hate that I have
to have
say this, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're good. You're damn good. And cool, too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It was a real thrill runnin' with ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But! I'm not losin' the next one! I'm
gonna show
you the coolest race ever
next time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Till then, Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ..."Till then"? I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Agh! I didn't run my heart out just to
have to say
this, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
As much as it hurts to admit, you beat
me. The
day is yours.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So let me congratulate you again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...But I will not lose next time! Be prepared to be humbled!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ..."Next time."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan sees the two of them off
the track as the crowd showers her in
applause. As if
enraptured by it, she
looks up to the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Machan! That was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I never thought I'd see another three-way standoff like that! I can't wait to see what comes next!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This beautiful sound. This beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's always loveliest when those two are
around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And they said "till then" and "next time."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've truly been blessed, with both
friends... and
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you both.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another great race next time.
Till then.
